fullPassage: Over the last few centuries, humanity’s collective prosperity has skyrocketed, as technological progress has made us far wealthier than ever before. To share out those riches, almost all societies have settled upon the market mechanism, rewarding people in various ways for the work that they do and the things that they own. But rising inequality, itself often driven by technology, has started to put that mechanism under strain. Today, markets already provide immense rewards to some people but leave many others with very little. And now, technological unemployment threatens to become a more radical version of the same story, taking place in the particular market we rely upon the most: the labor market. As that market begins to break down, more and more people will be in danger of _____________________________.

questions.passage: Over the last few centuries, humanity’s collective (A)[prosperity / poverty] has skyrocketed, as technological progress has made us far wealthier than ever before. To share out those riches, almost all societies have settled upon the market mechanism, rewarding people in various ways for the work that they do and the things that they own. But rising inequality, itself often driven by technology, has started to put that mechanism under strain. Today, markets already provide (B)[immense / minimal] rewards to some people but leave many others with very little. And now, technological unemployment threatens to become a more (C)[radical / moderate] version of the same story, taking place in the particular market we rely upon the most: the labor market. As that market begins to break down, more and more people will be in danger of _____________________________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) 번영(prosperity)이 급등했다. (B) 막대한(immense) 보상을 준다. (C) 더 급진적인(radical) 형태.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ prosperity – immense – radical: 세 곳 모두 원문과 문맥에 맞아요 ←정답
❌ ① poverty(가난)는 '급등했다(skyrocketed)'는 긍정 흐름과 반대
❌ ② minimal(아주 적은)은 '막대한 보상(immense rewards)'과 반대
❌ ④ moderate(온건한)는 '더 급진적인(more radical) 형태'와 반대
det.tip: prosperity(번영) ↔ poverty(가난) / immense(막대한) ↔ minimal(아주 적은) / radical(급진적인) ↔ moderate(온건한)

det.korean: 뒤의 than이 비교 신호 → 비교급 wealthier.
det.analysis:
빈칸 뒤에 than(~보다)이 있어요. than은 둘을 비교할 때 쓰는 신호라, 형용사를 '더 ~한'이라는 비교급으로 바꿔야 해요. wealthy는 -y로 끝나니 y를 i로 고치고 -er를 붙여 wealthier가 돼요.
far wealthier than ever before = 과거 어느 때보다 훨씬 더 부유한.

questions.passage: Over the last few centuries, humanity’s collective prosperity has skyrocketed, as technological progress has made us far wealthier than ever before. To __________ those riches, almost all societies have settled upon the market mechanism, rewarding people in various ways for the work that they do and the things that they own. But rising inequality, itself often driven by technology, has started to put that mechanism under strain. Today, markets already provide immense rewards to some people but leave many others with very little. And now, technological unemployment threatens to become a more radical version of the same story, taking place in the particular market we rely upon the most: the labor market. As that market begins to break down, more and more people will be in danger of _____________________________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: To ____ those riches = 그 부를 '나누어 주기' 위해.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ share out(나누어 주다, 분배하다): 늘어난 부를 사람들에게 나누기 위해 시장 방식을 택했다는 흐름 ←정답
❌ ① take over(장악하다) 문맥 부적합
❌ ② hold back(억누르다) 부적합
❌ ④ carry on(계속하다) 부적합

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: put that mechanism ____ = 그 방식에 '부담을 주다'.
det.analysis:
✅ ① under strain(부담을 받는, 압박받는): 불평등의 증가가 시장 방식을 '압박하기 시작했다'는 흐름 ←정답
❌ ② at ease(편안한) 문맥 반대
❌ ③ in balance(균형 잡힌) 반대
❌ ④ on hold(보류된) 부적합
